correctness.rationale: Exact coordinate counting gives each product. Equality implies equality of normalized root multisets and shift equal to twice the average reciprocal outer side length; this integer can only be 1 or 2. If it is 2 all side lengths equal 1. If it is 1, any unit side gives an extremal root absent on the other side under nesting; remaining side lengths at least 2 must all equal 2 by reciprocal averaging. Factor identities and an exact nonnested witness complete the proof. Independent finite integer/rational checks passed.
